manaNeeded: {2}{W}, plus an additional {W} if Glorious Angel was not foretold
notablePrerequisites: Any creature type besides "Angel" chosen with Conspiracy.
description:
Cast Glorious Protector by paying {2}{W}{W}.
When Glorious Protector enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling itself and any number of other creatures you control until it leaves the battlefield.
Glorious Protector and all other exiled creatures return from exile to the battlefield immediately due to Glorious Protector leaving the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2 any number of times.
End the loop by declining to exile Glorious Protector.
